pages.text: Jump to content Main menu Search Donate Create account Log in Main Page Talk Read View source View history Tools Appearance hide Text Small Standard Large Width Standard Wide Color Automatic Light Dark Welcome to Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia that anyone can edit. 266,512 active editors7,258,440 articles in English From today's featured article German reconnaissance picture of Sovetsky Soyuz The Sovetsky Soyuz class was a class of battleships begun by the Soviet Union but never brought into service. They were designed in response to the German Bismarck-class battleships, and would have rivaled the Imperial Japanese Yamato class and America's planned Montana class in size, although with significantly weaker firepower. Up to fifteen ships were planned, but the first four were plagued with construction difficulties as the Soviet shipbuilding and related industries were not prepared to build such large vessels. One, Sovetskaya Belorussiya, was cancelled after serious construction flaws were found. Construction of the other three ships was suspended shortly after Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union in June 1941. All three of the surviving hulls were scrapped in the late 1940s. pages.text: Jump to content Main menu Search Donate Create account Log in Help:Introduction to Wikipedia 36 languages Help page Talk Read View source View history Tools Appearance hide Text Small Standard Large Width Standard Wide Color Automatic Light Dark From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Introduction to contributing to Wikipedia Wikipedia is a free encyclopedia, written collaboratively by the people who use it. Since 2001, it has grown rapidly to become the world's largest reference website, with 7.3 million articles in English attracting billions of views every month. For a more detailed account of the project, see About Wikipedia. How you can contribute Don't be afraid to edit – Everyone can edit almost every page; just find something that can be improved and make it better! You can add content (using references to support your claims), upload free-to-use images, correct spelling and grammar mistakes, improve prose to make it more readable, or help with any number of other tasks. Just make sure it is you, not an AI improving Wikipedia. It's normal for new contributors to feel a little overwhelmed by all of our policies, but don't worry if you don't understand everything at first. It's fine to use common sense as you edit, and if you accidentally make a mistake, another editor can always fix or improve it later. USS Iowa firing a broadside A battleship was a heavily armored large warship with a main battery consisting of large guns, designed to serve as a capital ship. From their advent in the late 1880s, battleships were among the largest and most formidable warship types ever built, until they were surpassed by aircraft carriers beginning in the 1940s. The modern battleship traces its origin to the sailing ship of the line, which was developed into the steam ship of the line and soon thereafter the ironclad warship.
